newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds revived in afternoon trade on Tuesday to close higher in moderate business.

"Investors were waiting for lower levels during the morning before they would step in again," said one dealer, adding the bund futures did not break though their support levels, which pulled back buyers.
"The recovery was somewhat hesitant at first," said one dealer, adding the fear disappeared as soon as the December bund future broke the 99.50 level.
The December bund future was trading at 99.55 by 15.40 after touching a low of 98.27 during the moring.
The yield gap with Germany was steady to a touch narrower and some dealers said investors were charmed by guilder-bonds again.
"The yield of the 10-year Benchmark could easily slip to 5.85 percent," said one dealer, while another said it could drop to 5.75 percent.
The January 2006 bond rose 0.17 to 100.82/90, with a bid yield of 5.88 percent or 10 basis points below the April 2006 bund versus minus 12 on Monday.
